ValidationRule.description: #15836 Contact on case should be related to associated Case Account. Updated as part of user story #27296 on Gitlab. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations", NOT(ISBLANK(ContactId)), NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), AccountId <> Contact.AccountId )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Kindly make sure that the contact associated with the case is connected to the corresponding account.
